plugin.notes: 2.8.1: no one else can use your relay Worker: a Deploy-button Worker that still lets any desktop register (before relay 1.2.0) is refused until updated, and the Deploy button now asks for this desktop's owner token so the relay is locked from the first second. 2.8.0: per-phone keys, so the panel lists your phones and removes one at a time.

relay.notes: Relay 1.3.1: a placeholder or short RELAY_ADMIN_TOKEN is ignored (it can never become your relay's key), and malformed phone addresses are refused before they use your Durable Object quota. 1.3.0: per-phone keys.
